title: Discrete 1D Quantum Walk – interactive applet
description:
Interactive CindyJS applet for the discrete one-dimensional quantum walk of a qubit, designed for physics and mathematics education (school and teacher training). It visualises the qubit amplitudes as arrows, the probability distribution, the comparison with a classical Galton board, position and qubit measurements (single runs, exact ensemble average via density matrix, collected relative frequencies) and an animation of the individual computation steps. German/English, dark mode, responsive layout.

Live version: https://maxthematics.github.io/dynamicQuantumWalk/quantumwalk.html

Requires CindyJS 0.8 (loaded from cindyjs.org at runtime, not included).
notes: Supported by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) – Project-ID 491392403 – TRR 358.
